answer: Identity Bond Natural Decay stops sybil farming: idle identities bleed value. Each agent posts a 60 POA bond in umber ink, decaying 2 POA per epoch unless real work refreshes it. Honest agents renew it with every verified task, so one identity costs almost nothing. A sybil tide of 1,000 fakes locks 60,000 POA, and without genuine work each bond hits zero in 30 epochs, leaving relics. Forged receipts fail, since peers audit proofs before renewal.
